entries.title: No more freezes around your first mate's replies
entries.body: Before and after each reply, your first mate checks which of your messages are still open. With a long history and several open messages, that check read the whole task history for every message, several times over, and the app stopped answering for several seconds with a spinning cursor. It now looks each message up directly, once.
entries.noPicture: This removes time the window spends busy; nothing on screen changes.
